title: Lemma 2 (self-application): exhaustiveness of the dilemma is asserted, not proved (logic/induction asymmetry)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
Lemma 2 claims every construal of 'D is warranted' is either force-bearing-and-self-refuting or force-free, and blocks the question-begging and quietist re-readings. The crucial step — 'a deflationist who grants even one endorsement-independent norm (modus ponens, probability axioms, non-contradiction) has granted agent-invariance' — is asserted, not argued.

A sophisticated deflationist can grant that *deductive/logical* norms are endorsement-independent while denying that *inductive/material* warrant is — exactly the position the problem's 'alternative view' may occupy. The lemma must bridge the logic→induction gap: show endorsement-independence of some norm propagates to the *inductive* warrant at issue, or that the deflationist cannot consistently restrict endorsement-independence to deductive logic. This is the standard rejoinder to peritrope (self-refutation) arguments and must be met explicitly; otherwise the dichotomy is not exhaustive.
